lessons.trigger_condition: Tablet GPT needs to choose learning, maintenance, and improvement priorities from runtime, market, sync, and verified-learning signals while source changes must remain protected
lessons.symptom_summary: the existing query, job, and SELFREFINE neural models improved local decisions but lacked a verified meta-policy for choosing bounded maintenance actions and exposing auditable autonomy state
lessons.fix_pattern: add a verified-only autonomy MLP and deterministic controller that can rank only code-defined actions, retrain existing verified models, and emit non-executable capability proposals; require postflight-verified labels and keep all source changes behind regression-tested protected-main PRs

lessons.trigger_condition: verified market freshness, volatility, provenance uncertainty, coverage gaps, or provider error signals materially change
lessons.symptom_summary: fixed collection ordering could not explicitly raise market and exploration work priority when market conditions changed while preserving deterministic collection requirements
lessons.fix_pattern: derive bounded market signals from existing public evidence and apply only positive priority multipliers capped at fifteen percent for market jobs and ten percent for exploration jobs; never lower or skip mandatory collectors and never generate prices or trust

lessons.trigger_condition: coverage, sync, repair, or market-provenance signals indicate a missing capability that cannot be satisfied by an existing allowlisted runtime action
lessons.symptom_summary: autonomous analysis needed a safe way to identify future functions without turning learned text or model output into executable source changes
lessons.fix_pattern: emit bounded non-executable capability proposals with explicit evidence reasons and required gates; implementation remains a separate code change requiring targeted tests, full regression, integrity/security validation, and protected-main PR review
